missing_requirement_candidates.suggested_title: Founder Ownership of Mint and Affiliate Code 1
missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client separately requests that mint or affiliate code #1 be assigned to a specified wallet, followed by a context-specific completion claim. This is a one-off allocation obligation rather than a change to the general NFT referral-identity rule.
The exact valid and invalid referral-code messages are independently specified, implemented, tested, and reworded, but no frozen Requirement specifically owns this validation-feedback behavior.
